title: Budd Hopkins' abductees all drew the same symbol

tellings.quote: and he said I want you to draw what you see on the inside of the ship on the the table and they all drew the same symbol on the wall

plain: In New York in the 2000s, several people who say they were taken aboard alien craft were each asked to draw what they saw inside the ship, and according to the story they all drew the same symbol on the wall. The man who asked them was Budd Hopkins, an artist who spent years interviewing such people. The documentary filmmaker James Fox tells it as something he was present for, and he also names the journalist Leslie Kean. If true, it would suggest the people were describing a shared real experience.
